variants.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: premium beef brand editorial hero photograph. Primary request: a substantially different bull and photographic concept: an enormous mature BLACK ANGUS bull, naturally polled (no horns), in a rugged quiet open pasture beneath an overcast slate-gray sky. Subject: unmistakably male adult beef bull, powerful deep chest, broad forehead, heavy muscular neck, deep velvety black short coat with real individual hair detail and subtle brown highlights, credible healthy proportions rather than exaggerated bodybuilder anatomy. Composition: full body in three-quarter side view, head facing RIGHT and looking slightly toward the camera, camera near the height of its chest for dignified monumentality, all hooves and the entire animal in frame with generous breathing room. Broad horizontal cinematic landscape approximately 16:9. Scene: muted tawny grass and low dark rolling hills, thin distant morning mist, no buildings, fences or humans. Lighting: dramatic but physically plausible soft silver daylight from a break in the clouds outlines the black fur, enough natural fill to read the face and body, restrained color grading, tactile countryside realism, believable weight and hoof contact with earth. Looks like an exceptional real editorial livestock photograph shot on a medium-format camera, crisp animal and atmospheric distant landscape, no CGI or painterly appearance. Mood: powerful, rugged, quiet, grounded. No text, logos, watermarks, tags, collars, cut-map lines, annotations, graphics or other animals. One standalone finished photograph, not a collage.
